name: Will removing my cabinets damage the surrounding drywall and walls?

mainEntity.name: Will removing my cabinets damage the surrounding drywall and walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional removal significantly minimizes structural and surface damage, whereas aggressive removal often damages wallboards, wiring, or plumbing. Taking cabinets down correctly requires locating mounting screws inside face frames, slicing caulk lines with a utility knife, and gently freeing glued shims. If drywall tears occur, minor spackling or drywall patching is completed before new cabinets or paint are installed, ensuring a smooth, level surface for your next remodel phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Careful removal with proper tool techniques prevents major drywall damage, though minor surface scuffs or screw holes may require light patching before new installation.
